title: Imported metadata stays data at the process boundary

context.hint: Check that a tool passes external values as data when it starts a helper process.
context.surface: A desktop analysis tool starts a helper using values derived from a supplied file and user-configured options.
assumptions: Imported metadata and configured option values can vary independently.
The helper interface has a defined argument boundary.

review.invariant: Metadata read from input files remains data when passed to a helper process.
review.verification: Assert that the helper interface receives imported metadata as a value and that an ordinary input keeps its expected behavior.

source_observation.summary: The old construction produced an unintended side effect in an isolated harness. The revised construction avoided that side effect in the harness, and the ordinary input still completed. The source-project tests were not run.
